label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: All 35 AI-server listings are now in production after the 8 Vera Rubin products moved on 28 Sep, and all are disabled pending approval. The UAT cross-validation audit closed on 28 Sep, and a full catalogue re-check is due 30 Sep. Free-shipping and delivery-estimate text was removed from production on 28 Sep. Account hub and returns are still in testing past their 15 Sep due date, and 23 open items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Figma validation now has 54 defects, 16 fixed, with 10 more raised on 28 Sep. The sitemap fix (MR-1199) has not started, so smoke tests still cover 250 of 500+ URLs. AI Factory pages and the GDPR and Careers redesigns are in progress. No open item is past its due date.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Three new S1 bugs in production: wrong final prices across the Traditional, Modular and Nuclear AI Factory (25 Sep) and a Document API 502 on first request (28 Sep). Open S1 bugs rose from 2 to 5, with 63 bugs open in total. An IAM security hardening story with 9 subtasks started on 28 Sep under Platform Security. Eight items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Five delivery stories are done: the Marketing, Services Platform and Marketplace chatbots, conversational UX and the admin dashboard. Book a Meeting has been overdue since 4 Sep with no update since 2 Sep. The CSM Teams dashboard (UC-215) moved into development, due 30 Sep.
